indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_checkoff_items_pkey ON public.meal_checkoff_items USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_checkoffs_pkey ON public.meal_checkoffs USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_checkoffs_client_id_log_date_meal_id_key ON public.meal_checkoffs USING btree (client_id, log_date, meal_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_items_pkey ON public.meal_items USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_options_pkey ON public.meal_options USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_plan_assignments_pkey ON public.meal_plan_assignments USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_mealplan_per_client ON public.meal_plan_assignments USING btree (client_id) WHERE active
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_plan_versions_pkey ON public.meal_plan_versions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_plan_versions_meal_plan_id_version_key ON public.meal_plan_versions USING btree (meal_plan_id, version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_plans_pkey ON public.meal_plans USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meals_pkey ON public.meals USING btree (id)

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (meals m
     JOIN meal_plan_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = m.version_id)))
  WHERE ((m.id = meal_items.meal_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (meals m
     JOIN meal_plan_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = m.version_id)))
  WHERE ((m.id = meal_options.meal_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM meal_plan_assignments a
  WHERE ((a.version_id = meal_plan_versions.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (meal_plan_versions v
     JOIN meal_plan_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = v.id)))
  WHERE ((v.meal_plan_id = meal_plans.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM meal_plan_assignments a
  WHERE ((a.version_id = meals.version_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (meal_plan_id) REFERENCES meal_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (meal_id) REFERENCES meals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
